TBS-02.angle: Don't keep books in an ugly wobbly shelf — make them part of the tree
TBS-02.hook_seed: "I had 600 books on the floor of this corner for 2 years"

TBS-04.name: Material/Sturdiness Skeptic — saw "wood" that was particleboard, or assembled 3 wobbly shelves in 5 yrs; shakes before he trusts
TBS-04.barrier: "real or fake wood? thin branches hold books?"
TBS-04.angle: REAL WOOD · REAL CRAFT — touch & load proof
TBS-04.hook_seed: "This is my fourth bookshelf in 5 years. The first 3 are thrown away"

TBS-05.name: Thoughtful Child — adult child (buyer ≠ user) gifting a book-loving parent; tired of mugs/gift cards
TBS-05.barrier: "what to gift a book lover they'd never buy themselves?"
TBS-05.angle: The gift a book lover would never buy for themselves
TBS-05.hook_seed: "My mom has hundreds of books and I've given her a mug every year"

TBS-06.name: $2,289 Hesitator — loves it, in cart, stalls on price + custom + shipping a bulky piece
TBS-06.angle: Here's exactly where the money goes + free ship / made to order
TBS-06.hook_seed: "Yes, it's $2,289 for a bookshelf. Here's exactly where that money goes"

TBS-07.name: Provenance Skeptic / Authenticity-Seeking Aesthete — loves the piece but stalls: seen a cheaper lookalike, photos look "too perfect/AI", unsure it's real
TBS-07.desire: #3 freedom from fear (not scammed) + #8 social approval
TBS-07.barrier: "It looks great… but is it real? Photos look like AI; what if it's a knockoff or doesn't match on arrival?"
TBS-07.angle: It's genuinely handmade, solid wood, one-of-a-kind, arrives like the photo — proven by REAL footage
TBS-07.hook_seed: Three proofs of realness — real making · real object · real customers (no origin reveal; clone unnamed)
TBS-07.tier: "No two are alike — watch one become a bookshelf, by hand"
TBS-07.desire_full: Freedom from fear (#3 — not being scammed / not losing $2k on a fake) + Social approval (#8 — owning a genuine, one-of-a-kind handmade piece). Age overlay 45-54 (Meta).
TBS-07.snapshot: 45-54; fell for the tree bookshelf on the feed (saved it, keeps coming back) but stalls before the $1,900–2,289 click: has seen a near-identical piece cheaper elsewhere, read mixed reviews, and the site photos read "too perfect — almost AI/render." Wants to believe it's real; needs proof it's genuinely handmade, solid wood, and will arrive looking like the photo.
TBS-07.barrier_full: "It looks beautiful… but is it real? These photos look like AI. $2,000+ for a shelf — what if it's a knockoff, or doesn't look anything like the picture when it arrives?" (VOC verbatim: "Is this AI photos?" · "doesn't look anything like this" · cheaper lookalike elsewhere)
TBS-07.benefit: This is the real thing — shaped by hand, solid wood throughout, every grain one-of-a-kind, arrives exactly like the photo. Real proof (real making, real object, real customers) erases the scam/AI/knockoff doubt — WITHOUT naming the knockoff or revealing where it's made.
TBS-07.angles: A) "Made by hand, in motion" (real-craft footage; no origin reveal) · B) "What real solid wood actually is" (tangible authenticity + value; indirect on the clone) · C) "Real unboxing, real homes" (customer proof). [ledger: TBS-A13 / A14 / A15 — register on lock]
TBS-07.hook_ideas: A) "No two are alike — watch one tree become a bookshelf, by hand." · B) "This is what 80 pounds of solid wood feels like." · C) "Watch a real unboxing — start to finish, nothing cut out." (9 hooks total in the CPDs)
proof: real making footage (hands carving — NO location/origin)
weight & scale demo (80 lb, person for scale)
solid-wood cross-section + knock test
one-of-a-kind live-edge grain macro
real unboxing video
real-customer install UGC wall (40+ homes)

objections._about: Cross-cutting objections any buyer may carry (persona-db 'Cross-cutting OBJECTIONS'). Answer in the creative, never target them.
objections.colour: brown vs walnut vs oak: name the finish exactly as the product page does
objections.lead_time: made to order takes weeks: say it honestly with the scarcity line, never 'ships now'
objections.reassurance: a real business: the brand name on screen, the offer as the page states it
objections.legitimacy: is it real, is it AI: grounded, physical shots only; no glow-ray or floating renders

category_proof._about: Per product family: the objections the team banked (spry-creative-system analysis/pain-points-bank.md, ids kept) and the proof shots that answer them. Generated footage cannot prove craft or making (usp-directions: real capture only), so proof here is a page fact made visible: a legible use, scale with ACTOR A, a grounded grain macro.

objections.barrier: the table I have is the wrong size: it looks marooned, or it eats the walkway
objections.answer: the sizes on the product page, shown with ACTOR A for scale

objections.barrier: my last cheap table lifted, ringed or wobbled inside a year; what if I buy wrong again?
objections.answer: solid wood as the page states it, one grain from top to leg, grounded macro; never a dollar sum (KI-033)

objections.barrier: a sculptural top: where does the cup go, is it flat enough to use?
objections.answer: a cup or book resting flat and stable on the top, early, in a frame where the flatness is legible (the 22.67x winner's opening)

people around it using it

rules._about: Copy rules the team proved on this account (claim-and-craft-gate.md, pain-points-bank.md authoring rules, persona-db notes).
rules.owner_voice: first person in the body ('Mine was...'); second person only in the hook; never the 'your space deserves' scold (the documented 0-ATC click-trap)
rules.one_claim: one ownable claim per ad: it must not survive pasted onto another SKU unchanged (Reeves)
rules.said_aloud: every line must sound like a real person said it mid-sentence; vendor words fail: elevate, handcrafted, unique, functional art, timeless, stunning, transform (Bernbach)
rules.hook_types: console and sideboard conversions came from Product (HP) and Intrigue (HI) hooks, none from Call out (HC) (ledger 2026-07-27, small sample): on CST/SDB no V uses a plain call-out
rules.no_sums: never a beatable dollar total ('$1,509 once vs $300 x 3')
